Answers, clearly

Everything you need to know.

Still have a question? Our team is available through the contact channel you prefer.

How many Mega OTT connections can I select?

You can select up to three connections. Two connections receive 5% off and three connections receive 10% off.

Which devices are supported?

Smart TV, Android, Firestick, iOS, Apple TV, Windows and macOS are supported through compatible IPTV players.

Can I request a free trial?

Yes. Choose the Free Trial option and send your request through WhatsApp or Telegram.

How fast is activation?

Activation assistance is available after your order details are confirmed with our team.

What video quality is available?

Supported content and devices offer HD, FHD, 4K and 8K viewing options.

What does reseller access include?

Reseller plans include credit packs, customer-line management, renewal workflow and panel access.
